company.name: PAPER
company.shortDescription: Paper is an educational support system that provides personalized tutoring accessible to every student.
company.description: Paper is a developer of an educational platform designed to make personalized tutoring available to all students. It provides tutoring, after-school enrichment, and college and career resources to support students at every step of their academic journey. The platform connects students with a certified educator who can answer questions and provide contextualized feedback on exactly where the student went wrong in the learning process.

productsAndServices.description: A classroom-aligned, live virtual tutoring program for targeted K–12 support, delivered in consistent small groups with the same tutor and tracked through ongoing assessments.

productsAndServices.description: An on-demand, multilingual tutoring service that connects K–12 students with live tutors for unlimited, one-to-one help across subjects through a secure online platform.

productsAndServices.description: An asynchronous writing-feedback service that provides students with tutor annotations and guidance on written work, including content, grammar, and structure.

productsAndServices.description: A set of educator tools that helps teachers assign Paper support, generate standards-aligned learning checks, review student activity, and identify learning gaps.

productsAndServices.description: District-level design, launch, staffing, monitoring, and reporting services that support the deployment of Paper tutoring programs in schools.
productsAndServices.name: District Implementation and Program Services
